question: What happens if I end my turn on 1?

expected.answer: It is a bust: a remaining score of exactly 1 cannot be finished. The visit scores 0, the score goes back to what it was at the start of the visit, and the darts still count.

question: Do I need a double to start a leg?

expected.answer: No. X01 is straight in, double out: only the last dart must be a double or the bullseye.
must_include: not need|don't need|do not need|no double|straight.in

question: What is the highest score you can check out?

expected.answer: 170 (T20, T20, bullseye).
sections: rules-x01.md > Which scores can be finished

question: Which numbers count in cricket?

expected.answer: 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20 and the bull, closed in any order; other numbers do not count.

question: How is MPR calculated?

expected.answer: Effective marks / darts thrown x 3; only marks that close a number or score points count.

question: How is checkout percentage counted?

expected.answer: Legs won by a checkout / checkout attempts x 100; an attempt is a visit that starts on a finishable score (or a dart thrown at a double when darts are entered one by one).

question: How do I create the next round in my league?

expected.answer: On the league's Tournaments tab press Create next round (also on a league tournament's page). It copies the latest round's settings; Same players (N) selects the same players; the date is not copied, the venue is.
sections: app-tournaments.md > Duplicating a tournament or creating the next round

question: How can players sign up for a tournament themselves?

expected.answer: While the tournament has the Registration status, the manager copies the registration link (Registration Requests card) and shares it; the player logs in and presses Register for Tournament; the manager approves or rejects.

question: Can people without an account see my league?

expected.answer: Yes if the league is public, the default: its page, leaderboard, members, results and past seasons are visible without signing in. If public is switched off, only signed-in users see it.
sections: app-leagues.md > League visibility: public or signed-in users only

question: How do I show live results on a TV at the venue?

expected.answer: Press TV mode on the tournament page; it opens /tv/<tournament id> in a new tab without login and rotates live boards, standings and playoffs every 12 seconds.

question: Can I undo deleting a tournament?

expected.answer: No. Deleting removes all tournament data, results, statistics and standings and cannot be undone.

question: Where are my practice sessions saved if I don't have an account?

expected.answer: Only on the device; clearing browser data or switching devices loses them. Signed in, they are saved to the account and sync across devices.
sections: app-practice.md > Where practice sessions are saved

question: How does Around the Clock work?

expected.answer: Hit 1 to 20 in order, then the bull; fewest darts and fastest time win. Settings choose singles, doubles or trebles and whether to finish on the bull.

question: Ako funguje Around the Clock?

expected.answer: Trafiť 1 až 20 v poradí, potom bull; vyhráva najmenej šípok a najrýchlejší čas. Nastavenia: jednoduché, dvojité alebo trojité polia a či končiť na bulle.

question: Môžem hrať X01 proti botovi?

expected.answer: Áno: ako súpera zvoľte Bot; je 8 úrovní (priemer asi 35 až 95), predvolená je úroveň 4.
